data.body: Second recurrence repair complete. First uid-1000 fetch attempt failed before mutation with permission denied opening FETCH_HEAD, proving repo-root metadata (not just objects/) still had wrong root ownership from earlier host-side maintenance. After snapshot snap-0b895e50a1b392224, I normalized /var/gerrit/site/git/rebar.git to uid 1000, fetched the GitHub mirror as ec2-user, verified missing tree eb2a69d657661c310f964643a4e575cd7fa16e73 with cat-file, and ran full fsck --full --connectivity-only --no-dangling --strict clean. Post-repair wrong-owner sample was empty. Retried blackfly push: Gerrit change 2819 PS4 uploaded successfully (approvals reset as expected). This confirms the recurrence path was wrong-user host repair/maintenance leaving root-owned live Gerrit repo metadata/packs, not active JGit autogc/disk/EBS.
